remarks: Shippan Point Gem! Just a short walk to the water, this turnkey home in a coveted waterfront community is filled with natural light, vintage millwork, hardwood floors, and modern updates throughout. With its unique open floor plan, the main level offers a remodeled kitchen, spacious living and family rooms, and large dining area. Second floor features three sizable bedrooms, including primary suite with its own sitting area, walk-in closet and luxe bath. The third floor boasts a fourth spacious bedroom with a private bath. French doors open to an oversized deck with a covered sitting area. A backyard patio and manicured, fully fenced yard are perfect for relaxing or entertaining. With its two-car garage, partially finished lower level, and prime location near beaches, yacht club, train and downtown, this home is coastal living at its best! HIGHEST AND BEST BY APRIL 28TH, MONDAY AT 5 pm
